notes.title: The Island Waits. Q4 2025.
notes.notes:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="Sw1d-TvHxmo;full"][/previewyoutube][h3][i]You heard the call.[/i][/h3][h3][i]You answered.[/i][/h3][h3][i]But the island needs more time to prepare your suffering.[/i][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Total Chaos[/b] now descends in [b]Q4 2025[/b]... but don’t mistake silence for safety. The new trailer revealed during [b]IGN Live[/b] offers only a glimpse of what Fort Oasis has been growing in your absence.[/p][p][/p][quote][p][b][i]“Every shadow, every silence has meaning.”
[/i]– Sam Prebble, Creator of Total Chaos[/b][/p][/quote][p][/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984194/4b8894f09429288f41b3d94c75f15aab92daa612.png"][/img]
This isn’t just a delay.[/h2][h2]It’s a warning.[/h2][h2]The walls will rot slower.

Hoard what you can.[/p][p]🔻 Every decision drags you deeper.[/p][p]🔻 The island learns. And it remembers.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984194/136b99f58d650868f6a13526d054de83fa7d683c.png"][/img][/p][p]Once a total conversion of DOOM II, now a fully reimagined nightmare... [b]Total Chaos[/b] traps you in a fractured place where nothing stays still, and nothing lets go.

notes.title: 🕯️ Total Chaos Next Fest Demo Unleashes Terror
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=S4-yKdReWuE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]🕯️ The Nightmare Begins – Total Chaos Steam Next Fest Demo Now Live![/h3]

The horrors of Fort Oasis await! Total Chaos unleashes its free demo during Steam Next Fest from Feb. 24 – March 3, 2025.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984194/db3bba1b17aa36f6ee9cd93e1dd1b29ec999ad3d.gif[/img]

[h3]A Lost Island. A Desperate Fight for Survival. A Descent into Madness.[/h3]

Shipwrecked and wounded, you wash up on the shores of Fort Oasis, a long-abandoned mining colony swallowed by decay… and something far worse. A mysterious voice crackles through your walkie-talkie, guiding you deeper into the ruins. But as hallucinations intensify and reality bends, one question lingers—are you truly alone, or is something watching?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984194/d6ed753ae6eda74692e9a61a89109dc39b3bfca1.gif[/img]

[h3]💀 Survive Against the Unseen[/h3]

🪓 Scavenge & Improvise – Gather scraps to craft weapons. Axes, hammers—whatever keeps the horrors at bay. Firearms are rare, and every bullet is precious.

🕯️ A Warped Reality – As Madness takes hold, walls shift, hidden passageways appear, and hallucinations blur the line between opportunity and death.

🩸 True Survival Horror – Monitor health, hunger, and bleeding wounds while battling the unknown. But the greatest threat may be your own deteriorating mind.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984194/0dbb261edfc3b7ac59a8594cb5dd236d102a75f0.gif[/img]

notes.title: Total Chaos Brings Survival Horror to Fort Oasis in 2025
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=GzCyDe87yc4;full][/previewyoutube]

The horrors of Fort Oasis have been unleashed in the latest trailer for Total Chaos, which premiered during PC Gamer’s PC Gaming Show: Most Wanted 2024. From the mind behind [i][url=http://TurboOverkill.com]Turbo Overkill[/url][/i], this survival horror experience will put players to the ultimate test when it launches in 2025 on Steam and will even be VR-compatible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984194/db3bba1b17aa36f6ee9cd93e1dd1b29ec999ad3d.gif[/img]

[h3]Get an early taste of the terror with a free demo dropping in early 2025.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984194/66351b7fca4222e3e9703706990e63ae76434e3a.gif[/img]

As a Coast Guardsman stranded on the eerie island of Fort Oasis, you must navigate the decayed remains of a once-thriving mining outpost. Guided only by a mysterious voice over the radio, you’ll face relentless, evolving monstrosities and uncover chilling secrets. Armed with scavenged weapons and scarce resources, survival depends on wit and courage as you descend into the depths of this haunting landscape.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984194/d6ed753ae6eda74692e9a61a89109dc39b3bfca1.gif[/img]

Nine inescapable chapters, atmospheric environments, and a labyrinth of mystery await those brave enough to explore. With improvised weapons like pipe wrenches and makeshift axes, every encounter is a fight for survival. Can you unravel the secrets of Fort Oasis, or will the island claim another victim?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984194/0dbb261edfc3b7ac59a8594cb5dd236d102a75f0.gif[/img]

Wishlist [b][url=http://PlayTotalChaos.com]Total Chaos[/url][/b] on Steam today and follow Apogee Entertainment for updates on the demo and gameplay reveals.
